enabled_comment: Left off by default: scripts/tune_smoothing.py requires >= 3 calibration-set clips to tune min_cutoff/beta safely, and only 1 exists in data/clips_manifest.csv right now. Also, the previous fixed min_cutoff=1.0/beta=0.3 defaults were measured (scripts/measure_smoothing_effect.py) to drop a real rep's count 1 -> 0 on the one real clip tested -- do not re-enable without re-running the tuning script once enough calibration clips exist.
